notes: Computed directly from NYS Open Data 'MTA Subway Terminal On-Time Performance' (data.ny.gov, dataset f6rf-2a3t), the primary dataset behind Comptroller audits and this jurisdiction's existing 2024 value -- sum(on-time trips)/sum(scheduled trips) across all lines/divisions/day-types, via the Socrata API. Recomputed 2024 (82.18%) matched the existing repo value (82.2%) almost exactly, confirming methodology consistency. 'Terminal on-time performance': trains reaching the final terminal within 5 min of schedule -- WMATA-style 'wait assessment' is a different, non-comparable MTA metric, not used here.
